relationships.subject: distal nerve constriction
relationships.evidence_quote: the ratio of ATF3-positive neurons in the distal constriction group was significantly higher than that in the proximal nerve constriction or sham groups

relationships.subject: proximal nerve constriction
relationships.evidence_quote: The expression of HO-1 after proximal nerve constriction was significantly higher than that after distal nerve constriction and even those in the sham group

relationships.subject: proximal nerve constriction
relationships.evidence_quote: The ratio of CGRP-positive neurons in the proximal constriction group was significantly higher than that in the sham group

key_findings: Distal nerve constriction gave more persistent pain and more ATF3 in NFH-positive DRG neurons; proximal constriction caused more hypoxia (HO-1)
ATF3 in NFH DRG neurons at acute stage is a potential bio-signature of persistent pain
